next.reason: 1985 allows only the ASSIGN clause after the sort or merge file-name (format: SELECT file-name-1 ASSIGN TO implementor-name/literal). §2023:12.4.5.2 SR13 requires Format 4 for a sort-merge file, and Format 4 of §2023:12.4.5.1 also admits ASSIGN USING data-name-1 and an optional '[ [ ORGANIZATION IS ] SEQUENTIAL ]'. 2023 accepts sort-merge file control entries 1985 refused; a 1985 entry (ASSIGN only) means the same. Looser.
